title: A push of every branch never asks: the guard refuses it when it would update main or master on the remote, else allows it
why: Owner 16:08 CST Nov 10 (item 502, in chat, relayed by the coordinator): "I either want it approved or declined whichever is correct. I know for a fact I dont want to be asked."
note: Applies to --all and --branches pushes from every checkout. Builds on #2465 (agent-checkout refusal) once it lands on main. Rewrite record plain-push-asks in place: its 'asks' for --all/--branches is replaced (owner 2026-11-10 16:08 CST). Done check green on main: f024eae4e (batch 88, PR #2615, merged 23:50 CST Nov 11), with PR #2588.
